title: Parts of the Body
seo_title: Year 1 Science: Parts of the Body Worksheets (Label the Body)
standard_text: Identify, name, draw and label the basic parts of the human body.
meta_desc: Free Year 1 science worksheets on the parts of the human body: labelling a picture, the face, counting body parts and which part we use for each action. 100 questions with answers.
key_sub: Elbows bend our arms; knees bend our legs.
body_html:
How to think about it

We can name the parts of our body.

  • Head, neck, shoulders, arms, hands, tummy, legs and feet.
  • Elbows bend our arms; knees bend our legs.
  • Our face has eyes, ears, a nose and a mouth.
Example

Which part bends in the middle of your leg?

It is in your leg

Answer: the knee

Example

How many fingers on one hand?

Include the thumb

Answer: 5

Common mistakes

  • Thinking the elbow is in the leg.
  • Thinking the knee is in the arm.
  • Thinking we hear with our nose.

faq.q: What are the main parts of the body?
faq.a: The head, neck, shoulders, arms, elbows, hands, tummy, hips, legs, knees and feet.

faq.q: Where are the elbows and knees?
faq.a: Elbows are in the middle of our arms. Knees are in the middle of our legs. They let us bend.

faq.q: What are the parts of the face?
faq.a: Eyes, eyebrows, ears, a nose, a mouth with teeth and a tongue, cheeks and a chin.
